name: Dirt
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of all things, including the earth itself, formed at the beginning of time. Humanity’s origin is intimately connected to the earth, as God fashioned man from the dust of the ground and breathed life into him, making him a living soul. This connection is further illustrated in the New Testament when Jesus uses clay made from the ground to heal a blind man, demonstrating God's power to bring life and restoration even through the simplest elements of creation.
